description: A general judgment of foreclosure and sale of real property

court.description: The court, e.g. 'Circuit Court of the State of Oregon for the County of Multnomah'

defendants.description: Each defendant named in the caption, as printed

property_address.description: Paragraph 1: the address the property is commonly known as, as one line

legal_description.description: Paragraph 1: the legal description, as printed

deed_of_trust.description: Paragraph 2: the deed of trust foreclosed

dated.description: The date it was executed, as YYYY-MM-DD

recorded.description: The date it was recorded, as YYYY-MM-DD

dated.description: The date of the note, as YYYY-MM-DD

original_amount.description: The original amount of the note, in USD

amounts_due.description: Paragraph 11: the amounts due under the loan

prejudgment_interest_rate_percent.description: The prejudgment interest rate, as a percent number

prejudgment_interest_per_diem.description: The per-diem prejudgment interest, in USD

other_costs_and_fees.description: Other recoverable costs and fees, in USD

suspense_balance.description: Suspense balance, in USD; negative when shown in parentheses

total_with_prejudgment_interest.description: Total plus prejudgment interest, in USD

attorney_fees_and_costs.description: Paragraph 12: attorney fees and costs awarded

total.description: Total of fees and costs, in USD

post_judgment_interest_rate_percent.description: Paragraph 13: the post-judgment interest rate, as a percent number

deficiency_judgment_allowed.description: False if the judgment says the plaintiff is not entitled to a deficiency judgment

homestead_exemption_allowed.description: False if the judgment says the defendants are not entitled to a homestead exemption

judgment_signed_date.description: The date and time stamped above the judge's signature, as printed

is_signed.description: True if the judgment carries the judge's signature
